amends.preservation_rule: All v1.2 files, results, and dual-review requirements remain immutable historical artifacts.

curation_mode.name: machine_curated_computational_audit
curation_mode.llm_role: extract evidence only for quarantined records; self-reported confidence cannot admit a label

evidence_tiers.tier_1: Direct human A2A functional assay with explicit agonist or antagonist direction and a traceable primary publication.
evidence_tiers.tier_2: Unambiguous functional assignment in a primary source with incomplete machine-readable assay detail; sensitivity analysis only.

required: class direction agrees across qualifying evidence
no raw activity annotation belongs to an endpoint-excluded functional class
traceable primary publication with DOI or PubMed identifier

separation_of_gates.model_promotion: predeclared scaffold-split performance and uncertainty gate
